survivedFeatures: Basic table cell content and bordered layout
degradedFeatures: List markers (rendered as text glyphs rather than native Word list styles)
Exact Word line-spacing and paragraph kerning (approximated)
docxToPdf.recommendation: VIABLE for standard text, headings, lists, tables, and multi-page documents. Must clearly state that complex macros, SmartArt, and vector shapes are not supported.

degradedFeatures: Multi-column reading order: glyphs can interleave if X coordinates are close
Tables: reconstructed as sequential text rows rather than native OpenXML <w:tbl> without heuristic column-matching
failedFeatures: Scanned image-only PDFs (0% text extractable without OCR)
Exact font family matching (falls back to Arial / Calibri)
pdfToDocx.recommendation: VIABLE with strict scope: Works effectively as a digital PDF text and structure extractor into editable DOCX. Must reject scanned documents upfront with a dedicated UI warning.

bundleAndLicenses.mobileRisk: Combined uncompressed script size is ~4.8 MB (~1.2 MB gzipped). Safe on mobile if dynamically imported on demand (`next/dynamic`) so it does not affect initial page load.
